basics.name: Shakeeb Ahmad
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Full-stack Software Engineer with 6+ years shipping production web and mobile products — from Node.js/Express APIs to pixel-perfect Angular/TypeScript interfaces, with working knowledge of React and a track record of picking up new stacks fast. Currently a Senior Software Engineer on Cohesity's platform UI team (via MSys Technologies), driving Angular migrations and UI modernization across a 50+ engineer org. Independently designed, built, and published several Node.js/Ionic hybrid Android apps with 30,000+ downloads, and co-authored a peer-reviewed AI/NLP paper on neural poetry generation (ICDMAI 2022, Springer). Daily user of AI-assisted development tooling (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) and hands-on with local LLM deployment (Hugging Face) and applied ML workflows (Google Colab). Comfortable owning a feature end-to-end — API design, data layer, UI, and automated test coverage (Cypress, Jasmine, pytest). Outside of work: indie app builder and published Urdu/Hindi poet.

education.institution: Priyadarshini Indira Gandhi College of Engineering

highlights: Own end-to-end delivery of UI features and epics — from UX mocks to pixel-perfect, production Angular components — for Cohesity's data-security and management platform
Led migration of legacy AngularJS modules to modern Angular with zero regressions, cutting long-term maintenance burden
Built E2E (Cypress) and unit (Jasmine) test suites to prevent regressions and raise release confidence
Refactored legacy code to modern standards and safeguarded rollouts with feature flags, gflags, and router state guards
Proactively identify and drive improvements end-to-end, from filing tickets through shipping the fix; built internal bookmarklets and scripts to automate recurring engineering workflows
Collaborate daily with 50+ engineers, PMs, UX designers, and QA across a distributed org
Owned a full-stack revamp of the Admin app to modern UI standards in under a month, including dynamic nested navigation, breadcrumbs, and lazy-loaded modules
Improved rendering performance 200-500% on low-spec devices by eliminating unnecessary Angular change detection cycles
Extended the C#/.NET Core backend with new REST API endpoints and fixed backend bugs to streamline API consumption
Modularized and refactored legacy code; built reusable, spec-driven UI components consumed across the app
Designed and shipped Node.js/Express REST APIs powering real-time scraped data to 7,000+ active users
Built and maintained 12+ full-stack apps (Node.js backends with Ionic/Angular hybrid front-ends) with i18n support for LTR/RTL audiences (English, Urdu, Hindi)
Shipped push notifications, hot updates, and CI/CD pipelines that lifted user engagement 60%
Boosted user retention 200% via virtual scroll, infinite scroll, pull-to-refresh, and gesture-based UX

projects.name: HyperDict.js — Browser-Native Dictionary Engine
projects.description: Zero-dependency TypeScript library for GoldenDict-style StarDict dictionary lookups directly in the browser: bloom-filter/binary-search indexing, HTTP Range-request random access, offline caching, and a Chrome (Manifest V3) extension. Published to npm with CI (GitHub Actions) and Vitest coverage.

projects.name: dicapi — Reusable Web-Scraping REST API
projects.description: Node.js/Express API that wraps reusable web-scraping logic so it isn't rewritten per project; deployed as both a standalone service and as Netlify Functions.

projects.name: Sarbakaf Group — Hybrid Android Apps
projects.description: Independently designed, built, and published a suite of Ionic/Angular/Firebase Android apps (Qaafiyah Expert, Quran: Hifz Helper, OneSignal Push Manager, dRekhta); one app has surpassed 30,000+ downloads.

projects.name: Urdu & Hindi Poetry Generation using Neural Networks
projects.description: MTech research project: a neural system that helps poets past writer's block by generating rhyme- and meter-aware Urdu & Hindi poetry suggestions, with a cleaned poetry corpus released for other researchers. Presented at ICDMAI 2022 (2nd place, AI track) and published as a Springer LNDECT book chapter.

projects.name: AnalyseIt — Opinion Mining of Product Reviews
projects.description: Desktop tool to classify product reviews as positive, negative, or neutral with a batch-import pipeline. Won 1st position among 43 projects (TechnoMission, undergraduate capstone).

awards.title: 2nd position among 64 papers in the AI track
